response.sql:
WITH spatial AS (
  SELECT p.fundflux,
         (CAST(s.boxy AS DOUBLE PRECISION) - CAST(s.boxx AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) / NULLIF(CAST(s.boxx AS DOUBLE PRECISION), 0) AS yx_diff,
         CAST(s.aream2 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(CAST(s.volm3 AS DOUBLE PRECISION), 0) AS atv
  FROM scanspatial s
  JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref
  WHERE p.fundflux IS NOT NULL
),
per_source AS (
  SELECT fundflux,
         AVG(yx_diff) AS avg_yx_diff,
         AVG(atv) AS avg_atv
  FROM spatial
  GROUP BY fundflux
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_atv) AS cross_avg
  FROM per_source
)
SELECT ps.fundflux,
       ps.avg_yx_diff,
       ps.avg_atv,
       ps.avg_atv - o.cross_avg AS above_cross_avg_by
FROM per_source ps
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE ps.avg_atv > o.cross_avg;

assumptions.assumption: Database is PostgreSQL (the CONSTRAINT and quoted-identifier syntax indicates it), so CAST(... AS DOUBLE PRECISION) is used to keep the division exact-as-possible with no rounding.
Only scanspatial rows whose arcref matches a projects.arcregistry are kept (inner join); unmatched rows are dropped as the request says.
Projects with a NULL fundflux are not a funding source and are excluded.
A zero boxx or volm3 is treated as missing (NULLIF to NULL) rather than causing a division error, so it is ignored in the averages.

Per-record NULLs make that record's ratio NULL, and AVG ignores it, so only valid records count toward each source's averages. A source with no valid area-to-volume value is left out of the cross-source average and cannot be listed.
The cross-source average is the simple (unweighted) mean of each source's average area-to-volume figure, as the request states.

alternatives.interpretation: Keep projects with a NULL funding source as their own group, labelled '(unspecified)', instead of excluding them.
